name: Vaultwarden
description: A self-hosted Bitwarden server in Rust. Store passwords, passkeys, TOTP codes; sync with official Bitwarden apps.
compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: "${{cfg.signup}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
